title: Check: Similar Shapes: Area and Volume

questions.stem: Two similar triangles have areas of $8\text{ cm}^2$ and $50\text{ cm}^2$. What is the length scale factor from the smaller to the larger?
questions.explanation: The area ratio is $\frac{50}{8} = \frac{25}{4}$. The length scale factor is $\sqrt{\frac{25}{4}} = \frac{5}{2}$.
